name: Clay Golem
summary: A golem of clay that absorbs acid and may go berserk when wounded.

traits.name: Acid Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the golem is subjected to Acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of {ref:glossary/hit-points} equal to the Acid damage dealt.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.text: Whenever the golem starts its turn {ref:glossary/bloodied}, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The golem has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The golem makes two Slam attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks if it used Hasten this turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.onHit: and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Acid damage taken.

bonusActions.name: Hasten
bonusActions.text: The golem takes the {ref:glossary/dash} and {ref:glossary/disengage} actions.
